title: Jaguars GM James Gladstone: We value draft picks, but don't always use them in April

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaguars GM James Gladstone: We value draft picks, but don't always use them in April
sources.description: Jaguars General Manager James Gladstone doesn't view this week's moves to acquire safety Jessie Bates, defensive tackle Jordan Davis, and defensive tackle Davon Godchaux in the same light as many others around the football world have characterized them.
